purpose: Comment-grounded inventory for Natural Placement Judge V4.1 iteration.

contracts.direct_labels: Only verdict/ambiguity conclusions stated in free-text comments are labels.
contracts.issue_only_comments: Concrete observations without a direct verdict remain issue-only evidence.
contracts.agreement_comments: Agreement is relational to the exact frozen V2 result and is not an independent human verdict.
contracts.evaluation_claim: This corpus is development evidence and cannot support unbiased held-out accuracy claims.

verification.join_key: evalset_item_id == asset.id == v2 run directory ID
